Title: Update your Azure Cosmos DB .NET SDKs by 31 August 2022

Body.Content:
We are extending the retirement announcement of 1.x Azure Cosmos DB .NET SDK and the .NET Core SDK for SQL API from 31 August 2020 to 31 August 2022.

How does this affect me?

After 31 August 2022, Azure Cosmos DB will no longer make bug fixes, add new features, and provide support to versions 1.x of the Azure Cosmos DB .NET or .NET Core SDK for SQL API. If you prefer not to upgrade, requests sent from version 1.x of the SDK will continue to be served by the Azure Cosmos DB service.

What actions should I take?

  • Option 1: Update to version 2.x of the Azure Cosmos DB .NET SDK or the .NET Core SDK, which requires minimal code change
  • Option 2: Update to version 3.x of the Azure Cosmos DB .NET SDK, which targets .NET Standard.

If you have a support plan and require technical support, please contact us.
